name: google/gemini-4-carbon
description: Gemini 4 Carbon is Google's most capable Gemini 4 model, released on November 10, 2026 and positioned above Gemini 4 Argon. Google built it for long-horizon agentic work such as complex software engineering, full-stack web development, scientific research and cybersecurity defense. It accepts text, image, video, audio and PDF input with a 1M-token context window, always reasons before answering with low, medium or high effort, and supports function calling and structured output.
